summary: Satellos Bioscience filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing four poster presentations at the 31st Annual Congress of the World Muscle Society in Hiroshima, Japan, September 29 to October 3, 2026. The posters cover the Phase 2a BASECAMP and open-label TRAILHEAD studies of forazapadin (SAT-3247) in Duchenne muscular dystrophy, plus preclinical and FSHD design work. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanic is disclosed. This is a routine scientific-conference announcement, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
